reason: Controller review rejects the Plugin result because four confirmed P2 completion conditions are not implemented. (1) Full-space Graph still awaits Promise.all over every repo before producing results, so continuation is post-build array slicing rather than per-repo incremental publication and the first page cannot return while a slow repo is still running. (2) repo timeout is Promise.race only; it does not own/abort a child AbortController, so timed-out repo work continues in the background. (3) continuation records store no fact scope/fingerprint and readContinuation only checks canonical projectRoot; a controller runtime probe changed the source after page 1 and page 2 was still served (acceptedChangedSource=true). (4) explicit file/symbol fingerprinting recursively visits the entire projectRoot; a controller runtime probe changed only an unrelated source and invalidated the narrow session (unrelatedSourceInvalidatedNarrowSession=true). Existing focused tests pass 68/68 but do not exercise these four required behaviors, so green tests cannot support acceptance. Rework the same Plugin task: implement true per-repo incremental production with deterministic reconstruction, abort-and-settle repo deadlines, per-page source/fingerprint revalidation with typed retryable invalidation and cleanup, and narrow-scope fingerprinting that touches only the requested file plus necessary containing-repo manifests. Add regressions that fail the current behavior; preserve the accepted reader-only Search/Prime work and do not reopen Core or create Test.

Controller rejects rework1 after fresh diff review and runtime probes. Three prior defects are genuinely fixed and must be preserved: continuation pages revalidate source facts, explicit file/symbol fingerprints ignore unrelated sources, and cooperative repo deadlines abort the child signal and await settlement. Two confirmed requirements remain broken because the progressive model uses mutable whole-output snapshots plus only a boolean `settled`. First, structure.ts graphStablePageEntries deliberately filters every unsettled snapshot to the project root only; the public runtime probe returned status=partial, requested=1, attempted=0, nodeTypes=[project], relationCount=0. Even when repository outcomes are already spooled, no repo node/relation/ref can be emitted until the whole build settles, so this is a placeholder page followed by post-build pagination, not public per-repository incremental facts. The new test codifies attempted:0 and never asserts that a completed repo is present before a slower repo settles. Second, BuildRecord stores no terminal error. If a producer publishes a partial snapshot and later rejects, catch marks settled=true and #waitForProgress returns the old progressValue as a successful settled snapshot. A controller runtime probe publishing {phase:partial} then throwing terminal-boom returned errorPropagated=false with settled=true. This violates session-error broadcast, honest partial truth, and exception cleanup semantics. Focused 69/69 passing confirms the tests miss these behaviors, not correctness. New root-cause hypothesis for rework2: do not treat a mutable projected snapshot and `settled` boolean as the authoritative progress protocol. Model immutable deterministic repository-outcome chunks plus an explicit terminal outcome (success/error/cancelled). Public Graph page 1 must wait for and include at least one completed repo-derived fact/outcome while another repo remains unsettled (attempted >=1 and < requested), then cursor pages consume stable-key deltas without duplicates/missing facts. A producer error after any partial publication must be stored, broadcast to every progressive waiter/cursor, invalidate the continuation, and leave zero temp state; it must never become settled success. Add RED/GREEN tests for both exact controller probes. Preserve commit 490e3dad's source-revalidation, narrow-fingerprint, deadline, Search/Prime, Core and Guard work; no Test, no new task, no scope expansion.
